Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1, which must be 
 performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The gantry cranes for power house erection and maintenance 
 service have the follow Main lifting capacity of the main hoist : 900 K.N

 Main hoisting speeds :1/0.2 m/min abt
 Auxiliary hoisting speeds: 3/0.6 m/min
The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Abdo Hussen
